notes: GOONCATToken (src/GOONCATToken.sol) is an OpenZeppelin ERC20 with an argument-free constructor that mints the entire fixed supply of 1,000,000,000 GOONCAT (1e27 minor units, 18 decimals) once to msg.sender, the launch factory. No further minting exists and there is no owner, admin, pause, blacklist, proxy or upgrade path; the token uses no selfdestruct and no delegatecall. Creator tax: every transfer FROM the Uniswap v4 PoolManager 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90 to any other address is a buy and pays 2% (200 bps, floor-rounded in minor units) to the immutable treasury 0xFec44feFbC7B83Ce9Be3A36d647D36f45CFF59E2; the buyer receives the remaining 98%, and the PoolManager loses exactly the gross amount so v4 settlement balances. Transfers TO the PoolManager (sells and the factory's pool seed), PoolManager self-transfers, and every wallet-to-wallet transfer, including the factory's transfer to the MerkleDistributor and distributor claims, are untaxed and arrive whole. Tax rate, treasury and PoolManager are hardcoded constants; nothing can change them after deployment. No application contracts are deployed. The swarm's 10%, the 90% pool seed paired with IMD, the remainder to remainderTo and the platform's 1% fee are handled by the launch factory outside this contract. pool.fee 12500 is the launch policy's 1.25%; pool.initialPrice is provenance only, the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply using the deployed currency order.
